title: Bank a fire overnight
kid_text: Keep the coals small. Stay out of the smoke.
safety: Never build a fire inside an enclosed shelter, tent, or snow cave without ventilation — carbon monoxide is odorless and lethal.

steps.text: Rake the coals into a small pile.
Point thick logs at that pile.
Push the logs in a little at a time.
Do not take the fire into a closed shelter.

mistakes.text: You go to sleep with a tall flame.
mistakes.fix: Let it fall to coals first.
